svg.text: Target design, not yet deployed. Purple lines follow a compliance finding from detection to one Jira ticket, and an approved change back into a deploy.
Config, GuardDuty and Inspector evaluate the environment; a daily Lambda audits Okta and imports ASFF findings.
Security Hub CSPM tags each finding with SOC 2, NIST, ISO, PCI and HIPAA requirements (OCSF view optional).
EventBridge routes active findings to an SQS queue with a dead-letter queue.
The Jira creator claims an event_id in DynamoDB: new events open one ticket, repeats aggregate onto it.
Failed findings become framework evidence in Audit Manager.
Every 4 hours the SLA checker finds tickets past their deadline and escalates them.
Two allowlisted approvers approve in Jira; a signed webhook reaches API Gateway.
The handler checks the Parameter Store allowlist, records approvals, and resumes the Step Functions deploy.
GitHub deploys through an OIDC role (no AWS keys) using reviewed CloudFormation change sets.
Every key and token is in Secrets Manager under the platform KMS key; functions read them by ARN.
CloudWatch alarms watch every layer for failure, silence and tampering; SNS pages Slack and PagerDuty.
